name: flow-chapter-pipeline
description: Execute a single Flow chapter via cohesive chapter-batch edits, validate once with the fast lint and targeted unit gate, synchronize present-tense OKF docs, and run zero-context chapter review.

tasks.description: Ordered task worksheet relative paths within the chapter.

base_commit.description: Base Git commit SHA prior to chapter execution.

execution_mode.description: Execute the chapter in one warm batch pass or per-task turns (default chapter_batch).

review_mode.description: Run parallel code + quality review or a single combined review for Small slices (default dual).

reviewer_model.description: Preferred reviewer model option (default inherit when session is Pro/Pro-Next, or pass pro when session is Flash; falls back to flash on quota).

executor_agent.description: Optional custom agent profile for execution (default self).
